desc: Path meter for branching finals (scripts/core/evo_path.gd; briefs/design/GARDEN_MODERN.md section 3; docs/decisions/0022). Lines are keyed by the species that branches in content/rules/evolve.json; the swap, its level and the Ink lines are Evo's (decision 0024). Each end: form id (art at art/kin/<form>/<form>.glb, missing = the Boki waits), path (the affinity of its path tokens, garden_items.json), stat (its key stat, Care.STATS), type (its second type, lean.json), traits (any at trait_at or more gives a care pip), sports (games whose Cup Ribbons count, garden_prizes.json ids). The end with more pips wins; tie: the stat lead; still tied: undecided.
pips_doc: stat_lead: the end whose key stat is higher. lean_half / lean_full: the end's type lean at lean_half_at of full / full (Evo.LEAN_FULL). tokens_max: one per worn path token of the end's path. care_trait: an end trait at trait_at or more. care_toy: the most-used toy (rec.toy_use) trains the end's key stat. ribbons_max: one per Cup Ribbon in the end's sports.
